decision_conditions:
For the 1st Floor Flat: Assured Shorthold Tenancy Agreement (ASHTA) from 1st September 2019 – 6-month contract rolling month-by-month thereafter; ASHTA from 6th November 2020 - 6-month contract; ASHTA from 6th September 2023 (same tenant) - 6-month contract; ASHTA from 6th March 2024 (same tenant) - 6-month contract; details of corresponding Deposit Protection Scheme; Electrical Certificate dated June 2018.
For the 2nd Floor Flat: ASHTA dated July 2021; ASHTA dated September 2022; ASHTA dated October 2024; Electrical Certificate dated November 2015 and 2018.
For the Top floor flat: Electrical Installation Certificate dated June 2018; ASHTA from July 2018; ASHTA from November 2023; An EPC Certificate dated February 2017; Gas safety Certificates for Flat C from 2020 onwards and every year thereafter.
The following additional evidence: Gas safety Certificates pre-dating 2020; Floorplans of all three dwellings (Reference A101); Photos of all three dwellings; Council Tax record for Flats A and B with effect from 1993.
description: A Certificate of Lawfulness (Existing) for the use of the first floor as a two bedroom self-contained residential flat (Flat A), the second floor as a two bedroom self-contained residential flat (Flat B) and the third floor as a one bedroom self-contained residential flat (Flat C) (Class C3).
